skills.name: Sweet Dreams
skills.description: Launches Thunder Spears at enemies. Bad effects on enemies.  *Enemy Skill Evade Rate -30% (7 sec) *Enemy Skill Hit Rate -30% (7 sec) *ATK per sec x 300% Area Damage (7 sec)

skills.name: Titan Transform
skills.description: Turns into Colossal Titan and defends allies. Good effects on allies.  *ATK Speed +250% (10 sec) *Hit Rate +30%  (10 sec) *Reflects 80% of incoming skill damage as magic damage (10 sec)

abilities.name: Group: Attack on Titan2
abilities.description: Attack on Titan2 Tie-Up! Put Rangers of a group into a Team and HP buffs will be applied in battle. You must have a Team of at least 2 Rangers for group buffs to apply. The more Rangers you have in a Team from the same group, the stronger the buffs will be. (There are 5 buff levels.)
